partial_liquidation_share_increment.description: Minimum granularity of partial liquidation share. The share is rounded up to the nearest multiple of this value

rfq_default_max_slippage.description:
The exchange-wide fallback bound an unpriced RFQ's margin is computed
from, as a fraction of the underlying spot notional, for an asset that
carries no bound of its own. Per-asset bounds are on
/system/margin-config, already resolved. It does not bound the
execution: a quote wider than it is executable, and is charged what it
actually costs. The price bands are what bound the trade.
